images.filename: Colorized 1890 Sketch of the Condon Bank, Coffeyville, Kansas copy.jpg
images.caption:
This image is a colorized digital restoration of an original black-and-white pencil sketch of the Condon Bank, located in Coffeyville, Kansas, circa 1890. The original artwork is in the public domain.
The Condon Bank became historically significant as one of the two banks targeted during the Dalton Gang’s attempted double bank robbery on October 5, 1892, an event that ended the gang’s crime spree and marked a dramatic chapter in Old West history.

The colorization was created by James F. Linzey (2025) using high-resolution digital techniques to restore tonal balance, add naturalistic coloration, and preserve the original artistic details. The result is intended to enhance historical appreciation while maintaining the authenticity of the 19th-century artwork.
